component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Local AI chat with repository-grounded scientific sources

description.p: Ask the Model is a local-first GTK desktop interface for locally managed language models through an Ollama-compatible provider. It discovers completion-capable provider models, streams responses, keeps independent chat tabs and lets users explicitly save selected conversations to local History.

Version 0.6.1 corrects live GISTEMP chart rendering to use the complete pinned, revalidated source independently of retrieval excerpts, and recognizes clear natural-language chart requests alongside the explicit command. The chart remains limited to the qualified GISTEMP profile; no generic charts or model-authored data are enabled.

AtM remains an interface and retrieval layer. The external provider owns inference, AI model files remain separate artifacts, and the scientific repositories remain authoritative for their own model definitions, data, assumptions, provenance and validation.
Hardened grounded-turn durable commit ordering with final identity and cancellation gates, fail-closed pre-boundary persistence and regression qualification.
Corrected complete-pinned-source GISTEMP chart rendering and natural-language request recognition, retaining the qualified GISTEMP-only chart boundary.

Qualified semantic presentation and grounded Sources, explicit GISTEMP chart rendering with pinned-source History reconstruction, and default-OFF session-only repository optimizations with bounded qualified policies.

Saved Conversation History and State Hardening with explicit Save to History, exact-context restore, deterministic archived-conversation JSON mirrors, hardened SQLite state authority and least-privilege publication.

Startup Qualification and Snapshot Integrity with offline deployment and storage qualification, backward-compatible repository-state migration, deterministic local snapshot seals and fail-closed repository reuse.
Repository-Grounded Multi-Chat with validated immutable EWD/CBD/RMD snapshots, deterministic local retrieval, per-chat identity pinning, compact citations and exact-SHA source provenance.
Documentation and public-metadata consistency update with expanded first-time setup guidance, model-management documentation and corrected application metadata.
Installation and release-distribution correction with a directly downloadable Flatpak release asset and clarified dependency guidance.
Local Chat Baseline with local Ollama discovery, completion-capable AI-model selection, refresh progress, streamed chat and in-session history.
